description: Source code for handling git tags, including verification, dereferencing, parsing, and lookup functions.

classes.name: struct tag
classes.description: Represents a git tag object, including its metadata and associated object.

classes.name: struct object
classes.description: Generic git object structure, used for various object types like commits, trees, blobs, and tags.

methods.name: run_gpg_verify
methods.description: Performs GPG signature verification on a buffer.

methods.name: gpg_verify_tag
methods.description: Verifies the GPG signature of a tag object identified by its object ID.

methods.name: deref_tag
methods.description: Dereferences a tag to the underlying object, with optional warning.

methods.name: lookup_tag
methods.description: Looks up a tag object in the repository by its object ID.

methods.name: parse_tag_date
methods.description: Parses the date from a tag's tagger line.

methods.name: release_tag_memory
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a tag object.

methods.name: parse_tag_buffer
methods.description: Parses a tag object from raw buffer data.

methods.name: parse_tag
methods.description: Reads and parses a tag object from the repository.

methods.name: get_tagged_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID of the object tagged by a tag.
